messages.text: Grace and peace to the 12 tribes of Israel scattered abroad. I invite you to the great awakening, to call you out of the Deep sleep, and to destroy the lies that our enemy has given you. By doing this, I was led by Yahuah to build this Scrypture app, created for your purpose, with you in mind. May the Word wash and make you whole. Be encouraged.
messages.title: Grace and Peace to the 12 Tribes
